pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
Spread your arms wide, right here, right now!
Scream it out to the whole world,

[Build-up]
One, two, three, LET’S BURN IT DOWN!
Alright! Shall we begin?

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
I stand again in the middle of this world
I raise my broken body and hold on
Even if my heart is shaking, it's alright
'Cause now I'm gonna tear this world apart

[Pre-Chorus]
[Male Vocal]
A hundred times, a thousand times, I'll rise again
The sound of my heart is pounding like it's gonna burst
This time, everything will change

[Chorus]
I'm rising up again! (Hey!)
One step at a time, I'm moving forward! (Go!)
My confidence is turning into flames
I'll roar with all I've got!
I'm rising up again!
I'm rising up again! (Hey!)
Now I'm the one who's in the spotlight!
Everybody, put your hands up! (Bang~!)
Swallow every failure — this is where we start!

[Post-Chorus]
Jump! Jump! Jump! Right here, right now!
Jump! Jump! Jump! Believe in me!

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
Yesterday's defeat is now my breath
The fire inside me is about to explode
The me inside the mirror is running wild
No one can ever break me down again

[Pre-Chorus]
Swallow all your fear
Stand tall in the middle of this world
Everybody, shout it out together!

[Chorus]
I'm rising up again! (Hey!)
Now I'm the one who's flying higher! (Go!)
My confidence becomes a storm
And swallows up the whole world!

[Call & Response Drop]
[Male Vocal]
“I am!” I woke up again
“I am!” また起きた
“I am!” เธอตื่นแล้ว
I'M BACK ON MY FEET AGAIN!!!

[Bridge]
I don't mind if pain comes my way
Even if my bones are breaking, I'm alright
This moment is everything I have
And I'll never let myself go again!

[Final Chorus]
I'm rising up agaaaaaaaaain!!!
Now I'm becoming the liiiiiight!!!
I'll set my confidence ablaze and fly into the sky
The whole world will tremble beneath my feet!
I'm rising up agaaaaaaaaain!!!
Now I am everythiiiiing!!!
Everybody, shout it out together!
I'M BACK ON MY FEET AGAIN!!!!!

[Outro]
I'M BACK ON MY FEET AGAIN!!!!!
World, now it's your turn.
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
